author: @loveyoda
text:
《什么是静心?  烦乱中如何做到静心?  》 
你想要的一切,爱、喜悦、平安、丰盛、幸福，都是由静心而来。当你的心安顿了，外在的世界也就安顿了。
因为静心，你的心清澈如潭，映照天空万物，世间一切尽在其中。平静的心才能显像万物。
因为静心，你没有迷惑，没有犹疑，没有恐惧，你的内在随时都有一个更高的「我」可以回答你的问题。当内在静止，心灵的焦距才会清晰，你 也才能听到内在的声音。
因为静心，你不会寂寞，不会想找人填补你的不安空洞，你宁静喜悦，时时刻刻感到的是内在的丰盈，是超越一切的平静。
静心的人可以感受心灵的甜美，感觉生命没有条件的快乐，当你与自己在一起的时候，你是安然的，当你与别人在一起的时候，你也是安然的。静心的你往往能带给周围美好的安全感，让人喜 欢与你在一起。
那么，什么是静心? 
有人说:  静心是静静地和自己在一起。
有人说:  静心是专心地做手边的事。
有人说:  静心是无思无念，没有头脑的介入。
有人说:  静心是一种忘我与投入，一种专注。
有人说:  静心是没有过去和未来，只有对当下的 觉察。
这些定义都很好，因为静心是个人感受，只要感受是自己真正体验过的，一切都是好的。
要静心，先放松 
静心不是努力去追求什么，而是来自于放下与放松。
不是追寻蝴蝶的足迹，而是从自己的内在开出喜悦的花。
生活在忙碌与盲目之中，你的心能安静下来吗? 放松是对于当下的觉察，是把自己从紧绷的状态里松开来，
是放下对于「我」的一切执着。
放松不只有益心灵，也有益健康。
就像一把琴弹久了，反覆被拨弄的琴弦不知哪一 天就可能断了，人也一样，如弦一般紧绷的日子过久了，不知哪一天也就可能崩溃了。
「努力放松」是个悖论，放松与努力正好是相反的，所以许多时候，与其对别人喊加油，不如提醒对方别再努力了，放松吧。
或许我们自己也是那个需要被提醒的人，或许在不知不觉之间，我们总是对某件事过度努力，过 度在意，无形之中给了自己太多达不到或得不到 的压力，所以也要记得常常提醒自己，放下吧，放松吧。

text:
(✿❦ ͜ʖ ❦) ☞ How to make tokbokki with super spicy sauce is simple 

- The ingredients need to be prepared 

600g Korean rice cake 
4 thin Korean fish cakes 
Korean chili sauce 
Korean chili powder 
500ml chicken broth 
1 onion 
2 carrots Garlic, purple onion, scallion 100g of white sesame seeds and black sesame seeds Cooking oil 
Spices: Salt, sugar, seasoning, pasta, pepper ... 
Tools: Non-stick pan, knife, bowl, ladle ... 

- How to make traditional tokbokki

Step 1: Preliminary processing of raw materials
-Rice cakes are soaked in cold water for about 1 hour and then picked out and drained. Use a knife to cut the rice cake in half to taste. Fish cake cut into square pieces to taste. Onions washed, peeled and chopped. Carrots are washed, peeled, and sliced into long fibers. Garlic and purple onions are washed, peeled, crushed and chopped. Scallions are washed, cut off the roots and chopped. White and black sesame seeds in a pan roast.

Step 2: Make super spicy tokbokki sauce 
-Add the chopped garlic and shallots in a saucepan. Next, you pour the chicken broth, stir well. Wait for the water to boil, then add onions and carrots, season with spices salt, pepper, sugar, and seeds to taste. Boil for about 5 minutes, then turn down the heat and then add 5 tablespoons of chili sauce and 3 teaspoons of chili powder, stir well until the sauce is thick, then draw into a bowl.

Step 3: Sauté tokbokki with sauce 
-Put the pan on the stove, pour the cooking oil and the tokbokki rice cake and fry it until the rice cakes are golden, then add the fish cakes, stirring for 5 minutes. After the rice cakes and fish cakes are done, pour in the super spicy sauce and stir-fry them until the mixture is fully cooked, thick.

Step 4: Present and enjoy 
-After the tokbokki rice cake is finished, you just need to scoop out a plate or bowl, sprinkle a little sesame and green onions on top to enjoy your results!

author: @seradibo553
text:
With the advent of smartphones, our lives have become easier. It has revolutionized the way we communicate and access to information. However as with many technologies, there are some advantages and disadvantages of having such a life-savior device. It contains thousands of unique inventions and keeps us connected all the time as well as desocializing people by making them addicted to itself.

First of all, smartphones enable us access any information on the internet instantly anywhere. Lots of productivity tools can be downloaded and used on the smartphones. In addition to traditional voice call, if both speakers have smartphones, they can video call, allowing speakers to see each other. A group of people can even have real-time conversations. Accordingly, meetings can be held online and the money spent can be lowered.

However, smartphones also have some disadvantages. Since they keep people connected all the time, people are always monitored. Therefore, you are bound to work eternally.

However, smartphones also a have a number of disadvantages such as constant distraction and waste of time. People spend a lot of time on their phones interacting with different applications. The notifications from various apps keep people busy and distracted all the time. What is more, smartphones feature many games and entertaining apps. These apps and games take up a lot of time and cause people to waste hours every day.

Nevertheless, smartphones have some harmful effects on people such as eye sight problems and lack of concentration. Using smartphones over an extended period will sever the eyes. Moreover, the notifications from applications constantly distract people. As a result, people who own smartphones will be affected negatively in their daily lives.

In conclusion, using smartphones improves our daily lives by making access to information easier and by making communication with our friends and family more convenient. Yet, the use of smartphones might also bring about disadvantages such as lack of concentration and eye problems related excessive usage. Therefore, smartphones should be used with caution.

text: i don't have a single exo-l friend, the few people into kpop are armies(i mean they know exo, coz me but they arent too interested in them so they only know the latest mvs, love shot, obsession and tempo😕) and since i dont get to meet them due to covid, i cant share the awesomeness of exo with them....its lonely....utube is my only option....i wanted to share the journey of how, how i became an exo-l and many more things....

author: @byunbaekhyun8722
text: i first saw 3 school seniors perform on growl, that was the first time i heard a korean song and saw such a cool dance, they did the same steps as their video where they cud....i was in a hostel with minimum net, a friend had exo written on the cap and they said its the coolest group....my second drama with hostel friends only happened to be exo next door, i fell for chanyeol, nut cudnt complete the drama, we had our 10th boards in 2016, and it was holidays, soni found it online at home and completed it....

author: @byunbaekhyun8722
text: then, i remembered the cool song and watched the MVs, the famous ones, growl, wolf, monster, overdose, etc....and well i felt they r coolest people alive, so i watched, so i married an anti-fan, scarlet heart, kim seondal, the playing the mafia game, the witness, sweet combat, ms. granny(chinese), too young: never gone, its okay thats love, my annoying brother, 100 days my prince....and i just kept rewatching the old mvs and monster and ko ko bop and all, i never heard their singles coz i liked the mvs and the stunts and creativeness and felt it wudnt be the same....i wasnt a frequent listener but i was someone who was happy for their success and kept watching their latest MVs....until 7 months ago, when i first checked out exo-cbx, the thought of subunits made me feel other members werent valued as much and they only picked 3 of them, ig i. always left out or something, i didnt want that, but it wasnt true, they worked harder to give us more content and realising exo-sc was also there and that d.o., xiumin and suho were in the military and chen was about to enlist, and they had solos and osts, i fell for cbx and then i streamed baekhyuns solos, all music from the box, everything amd anything they had, suho's solo album, chen's album, the covers they all made, i fell for hideto matsumoto's music due to chanyeol's cover of rocket dive, i started following them all on social medias, i brought their posters and now my feeds and life is full of them, i am in love with everything about them, i watched on all reality shows and ig lives and anything and everything available....while my friends were already armies, i never really felt any connection to bts nor did I feel they r too cool, plus exo's vocals, man! their looks, man! their cuteness, fights, exposing each other, their humour, their humbleness....their everything is too good, i cant look at anyone else, i converted my mother and sis to like exo, they now know them and listen to them at times, but this story and all, and ths fact we all have some reason we watched them and why we fell for them, i cant share with anyone...so here i post it...i wish there was some group for broke exo-ls where i cud personally talk to people and make friends....i love u too, thank you if u read this, stay safe, stay healthy

Material
1 kg of cabbage
1 onion
2 garlic cloves
1 ginger branch
1 pear
1 carrot
1 white radish
5 g chives
5 g green onion
20 g of glutinous rice flour
Fish sauce
Street
Salt powder
Korean chili powder

Tutorial
Step 1: Preliminary processing of raw materials
-You take the cabbage washed to drain and then cut the cabbage in half or four.

-After that, the cabbage goes to salt. You are up to time per single edit and auster to the two time of Lettuce for about 2 hours. Improve it every 30 minutes so you don't get salty.

Step 2: Make spices to marinate
-You take half a pear and peel it to cut a small piece, do the same with half an onion and add garlic, ginger and then bring it all to puree. You can add chili to make the kimchi more spicy.

-Next, use the other half of the pear that has left the string. Radishes, carrots also do the same. Action, chives you split the chunk about 3 cm.

-Then, you bring 20 g of glutinous rice powder dissolved with 200 ml of water and boil it on the stove, at the same time stir until strange, then turn off the heat. When the dough has cooled, add 1 teaspoon of sugar, 2 tablespoons of fish sauce and about 40 grams of Korean chili powder and the mixture of ground spices and stir well.

-Next, you put all the shredded pears, radish, carrots, onions, chives and mix well to get the best seasoning.

Step 3: Improvement 
-Once the cabbage has been 2 times rinse under the tap water 3-4 times to improve the salty things.

-After washing, let the water dry and prepare a container with a lid to hold the kimchi. Once the cabbage has dried, spread the cabbage from the outside into the cabbage.

Step 4: Kimchi is completed
-Finished seasoning the cabbage and then you put it all into the box and cover tightly. You leave the box of kimchi in a cool place for 2 to 3 days to ferment the cabbage. After the kimchi is finished, put the kimchi in the fridge and eat it gradually.

(✿❦ ͜ʖ ❦) ☞ How to make tokbokki with super spicy sauce is simple 

- The ingredients need to be prepared 

600g Korean rice cake 
4 thin Korean fish cakes 
Korean chili sauce 
Korean chili powder 
500ml chicken broth 
1 onion 
2 carrots Garlic, purple onion, scallion 100g of white sesame seeds and black sesame seeds Cooking oil 
Spices: Salt, sugar, seasoning, pasta, pepper ... 
Tools: Non-stick pan, knife, bowl, ladle ... 

- How to make traditional tokbokki

Step 1: Preliminary processing of raw materials
-Rice cakes are soaked in cold water for about 1 hour and then picked out and drained. Use a knife to cut the rice cake in half to taste. Fish cake cut into square pieces to taste. Onions washed, peeled and chopped. Carrots are washed, peeled, and sliced into long fibers. Garlic and purple onions are washed, peeled, crushed and chopped. Scallions are washed, cut off the roots and chopped. White and black sesame seeds in a pan roast.

Step 2: Make super spicy tokbokki sauce 
-Add the chopped garlic and shallots in a saucepan. Next, you pour the chicken broth, stir well. Wait for the water to boil, then add onions and carrots, season with spices salt, pepper, sugar, and seeds to taste. Boil for about 5 minutes, then turn down the heat and then add 5 tablespoons of chili sauce and 3 teaspoons of chili powder, stir well until the sauce is thick, then draw into a bowl.

Step 3: Sauté tokbokki with sauce 
-Put the pan on the stove, pour the cooking oil and the tokbokki rice cake and fry it until the rice cakes are golden, then add the fish cakes, stirring for 5 minutes. After the rice cakes and fish cakes are done, pour in the super spicy sauce and stir-fry them until the mixture is fully cooked, thick.

Step 4: Present and enjoy 
-After the tokbokki rice cake is finished, you just need to scoop out a plate or bowl, sprinkle a little sesame and green onions on top to enjoy your results!

(✿❦ ͜ʖ ❦) ☞ How to make tokbokki with super spicy sauce is simple 

- The ingredients need to be prepared 

600g Korean rice cake 
4 thin Korean fish cakes 
Korean chili sauce 
Korean chili powder 
500ml chicken broth 
1 onion 
2 carrots Garlic, purple onion, scallion 100g of white sesame seeds and black sesame seeds Cooking oil 
Spices: Salt, sugar, seasoning, pasta, pepper ... 
Tools: Non-stick pan, knife, bowl, ladle ... 

- How to make traditional tokbokki

Step 1: Preliminary processing of raw materials Rice cakes are soaked in cold water for about 1 hour and then picked out and drained. Use a knife to cut the rice cake in half to taste. Fish cake cut into square pieces to taste. Onions washed, peeled and chopped. Carrots are washed, peeled, and sliced into long fibers. Garlic and purple onions are washed, peeled, crushed and chopped. Scallions are washed, cut off the roots and chopped. White and black sesame seeds in a pan roast.

Step 2: Make super spicy tokbokki sauce Add the chopped garlic and shallots in a saucepan. Next, you pour the chicken broth, stir well. Wait for the water to boil, then add onions and carrots, season with spices salt, pepper, sugar, and seeds to taste. Boil for about 5 minutes, then turn down the heat and then add 5 tablespoons of chili sauce and 3 teaspoons of chili powder, stir well until the sauce is thick, then draw into a bowl.

Step 3: Sauté tokbokki with sauce Put the pan on the stove, pour the cooking oil and the tokbokki rice cake and fry it until the rice cakes are golden, then add the fish cakes, stirring for 5 minutes. After the rice cakes and fish cakes are done, pour in the super spicy sauce and stir-fry them until the mixture is fully cooked, thick.

Step 4: Present and enjoy After the tokbokki rice cake is finished, you just need to scoop out a plate or bowl, sprinkle a little sesame and green onions on top to enjoy your results!

author: @camille8221
text: It took me long to start that message because I couldn't believe that day had come. Park Chanyeol, you are one of the most amazing people I have had the pleasure of meeting, even if through the screen of a phone, and I am immensely grateful for all the happy moments you have brought me over these almost three years. Did you know you were the first EXO member I had contact with? I had already heard of you, but it was only when I saw a picture of you and thought "wow he's really beautiful" that I decided to listen to the songs and that was one of the best decisions I made. Gradually I became more and more enchanted by all your charms, especially your voice. I have already said about how much I love your voice and how she manages to calm me down and bring me a smile, but I never get tired of saying how much you always makes me fall in love once again when you sing. And speaking of smiles, thank you for bringing the happiness I needed in my bad times, Chanyeol, you have no idea how much you made me happy all this time and will continue to do when I come back, because I will be here waiting for you, so do not worry. It hurts to have to say "see you later" to you, but it's ok, because I know we'll have you back and I'll look forward to the moment to say "welcome back". We love you, Chanyeol, take care of yourself during this time away and continue to be that wonderful person that you are and that brings us so many good feelings, just as we will continue by your side and with open arms. ❤️❤️❤️
